history.body: Hi, we’re looking around Seberang Jaya for a place to buy and Pearl Residences came up. We have a young child and need a separate bedroom for them, so could you tell me about the 3-bedroom layout and the usual monthly costs?

Type A is 900 sq.ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony, so there’s a separate bedroom available for your child. The layout has an entrance foyer, open-plan living/dining and kitchen, and avoids a long internal corridor; it also includes a small storage area. The bedrooms are shown accommodating queen-sized beds, though exact furniture fit should be checked against the approved plan.

The maintenance fee is RM0.18 psf inclusive of sinking fund, which works out to RM162 per month for 900 sq.ft. That’s the verified maintenance amount, not a confirmed all-in monthly total. I’m checking whether there are any other regular project charges so I can give you a more complete picture. A viewing could also help you assess the bedroom arrangement for your family.

Thanks, that sounds like it could suit our family, especially having a separate room for our child. We’re looking for our own stay. Please let me know the other regular charges once confirmed; does the price include a car park? We’d want to understand the costs before deciding about a viewing.

That makes sense—you should have the costs clearer before deciding about a viewing. The pricing structure can include a separate car-park premium; the reference schedule shows premiums of RM15k, RM20k or RM30k depending on the unit and allocation, while some configurations are listed with two car parks. So I can’t confirm whether the price you saw includes a car park without the specific unit’s price schedule. The confirmed maintenance is RM162 per month, inclusive of sinking fund; the other regular project charges are still unconfirmed. I’ll clarify the car-park details for you, then you can decide whether you’d like to view.
